ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity to low-intensity pixels; surface area is approximately 96% dark pigment with sparse, high-intensity white clusters isolated at the distal tips and specific focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is a continuous low-intensity black region. Distinct high-contrast white contiguous blobs are located at the lateral-most tips of both lobes. A localized circular high-intensity ring is visible in the mid-region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp, narrow V-shaped depression with an approximate interior pixel angle of 42 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile. The left lobe trailing edge features a significant, deep rectangular notch. The right lobe exhibits a series of smaller-amplitude jagged peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward trajectory on the leading edges, tapering into acute points at the lateral fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white pixels located at both lateral tips. A distinct high-contrast circular annulus is localized on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple light-grey linear pixel disruptions; one prominent diagonal rake mark on the right lobe and several shorter, unaligned linear marks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A deep, non-uniform indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe. A distinct white circular ring-shaped scar on the left lobe. Multiple linear rake marks across the surface of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A perfectly circular white ring-shaped mark on the left lobe and an unusually deep rectangular-shaped cutout on the left lobe's trailing edge.
